parked_for: Travel 3 / At the border — not on the path yet. Do not invent a node until James asks.
why: James: "wondering if the vocab in this unit is a bit too diffuse — customs, revision, diploma". Knowledge & travel was 24 study words plus 11 border-and-planning travel words, and leaf_travel_b1 sits four slots earlier at the 36-word ceiling, so there was no room to merge them. The study half became School 4; these eleven wait for a travel unit of their own. Everything needed to rebuild them is here: tiles with icons, one sentence per lemma, and the four Use rewrites.
